findings.explanation: Implies the search alerts on archive utilisation; it only lists configuration changes, and an alert with 'configured threshold' has no threshold in the SPL.
findings.quote: Alerts on UC-15.3.23 — Video, Retention, and, Cloud, Archive — using `index=meraki` sourcetype `meraki:audit`
findings.suggested_fix: State clearly that it reports retention and camera setting changes in the Meraki audit log.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: Title says 'Storage Utilization' but the SPL detects audit-log configuration changes only.
like() is case-sensitive, so like(page, "%camera%") may miss pages such as 'Camera > ...'; and like(label, "%schedule%") is not limited to cameras, which will pull in unrelated schedule changes.

summary: The title, visualization and detailedImplementation promise storage utilisation, but the SPL only lists camera-related Meraki audit-log changes, as the data sources note admits. The deliverable is not what the title says.
